def _count_lines(text: str) -> int:
    if not text:
        return 0
    n = text.count("\n")
    if not text.endswith("\n"):
        n += 1
    return n


def _rstrip_lines(s: str) -> str:
    """Drop trailing whitespace on every line, keep EOL and leading as-is."""
    return "\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in s.split("\n"))


def _find_normalised(before: str, needle: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Ranges [start, end) in `before` matching `needle` after stripping
    trailing whitespace on every line of both. Leading whitespace is kept
    (indent is meaningful); only trailing is treated as file noise.

    Both inputs must already be LF-normalised (see caller). Returns
    non-overlapping ranges in source order.
    """
    if not needle:
        return []
    needle_lines = needle.split("\n")
    file_lines = before.split("\n")
    k = len(needle_lines)
    if k > len(file_lines):
        return []
    needle_norm = [ln.rstrip() for ln in needle_lines]
    # Precompute start offsets of every file line.
    line_starts: list[int] = [0]
    off = 0
    for ln in file_lines[:-1]:
        off += len(ln) + 1
        line_starts.append(off)

    matches: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for j in range(len(file_lines) - k + 1):
        ok = True
        for i in range(k):
            if file_lines[j + i].rstrip() != needle_norm[i]:
                ok = False
                break
        if not ok:
            continue
        start_off = line_starts[j]
        end_off = line_starts[j + k - 1] + len(file_lines[j + k - 1])
        if matches and start_off < matches[-1][1]:
            continue
        matches.append((start_off, end_off))
    return matches


def _mark_invisible(s: str) -> str:
    """Render a line with invisible characters made visible.

    Trailing whitespace becomes \u2423 (space) / \u21e5 (tab). Tabs
    anywhere else also become \u21e5. Internal spaces stay as spaces.
    """
    stripped = s.rstrip()
    tail = s[len(stripped):]
    out = stripped.replace("\t", "\u21e5")
    if tail:
        out += tail.replace(" ", "\u2423").replace("\t", "\u21e5")
    return out


def _similar_lines(before: str, needle: str, n: int = 3) -> list[tuple[int, str, float]]:
    """Top-n file lines (1-based) most similar to the first needle line.

    Returns [(line_no, marked_text, ratio), ...], sorted by ratio desc.
    Used when both exact and normalised matching fail.
    """
    import difflib
    needle_first = needle.split("\n", 1)[0]
    out: list[tuple[int, str, float]] = []
    for i, line in enumerate(before.split("\n"), start=1):
        r = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, line, needle_first).ratio()
        if r > 0.5:
            out.append((i, _mark_invisible(line), r))
    out.sort(key=lambda x: -x[2])
    return out[:n]

def execute(
    self,
    backend: Backend,
    fmt: Any,
    file_path: str,
    search: str,
    replace: str,
    occurrence: int | str = 1,
    search_repr: bool = True,
    regex: bool = False,
    **_: Any,
) -> Result:
    before_raw = backend.read(file_path)
    # CRLF normalization: match in LF-space, restore on write.
    had_crlf = "\r\n" in before_raw
    before = before_raw.replace("\r\n", "\n") if had_crlf else before_raw

    # --- regex mode ---------------------------------------------------
    if regex:
        return _replace_regex(
            backend, file_path, before, before_raw, had_crlf,
            search, replace, occurrence,
        )

    # --- literal mode: unwrap repr-quoted search if asked ----------------
    needle = search
    if search_repr:
        stripped = search.strip()
        if (len(stripped) >= 2
                and stripped[0] in ("'", '"')
                and stripped[-1] == stripped[0]):
            try:
                needle = ast.literal_eval(stripped)
            except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
                needle = search
    if "\r\n" in needle:
        needle = needle.replace("\r\n", "\n")
    repl = replace
    if "\r\n" in repl:
        repl = repl.replace("\r\n", "\n")

    # --- Tier 1: byte-exact ------------------------------------------
    tier = 1
    total = before.count(needle)
    ranges: list[tuple[int, int]] | None = None
    if total == 0:
        # --- Tier 2: trailing-whitespace-normalised -------------------
        norm = _find_normalised(before, needle)
        if norm:
            tier = 2
            ranges = norm
            total = len(norm)

    if total == 0:
        # --- Tier 3: no match, show similar --------------------------
        similar = _similar_lines(before, needle, n=3)
        extra = ""
        if similar:
            extra = "\n  Similar lines (invisible chars shown):\n" + "\n".join(
                f"    L{ln}: {txt!r}" for ln, txt, _ in similar
            )
        return Result(
            status="error",
            message=(f"Строка не найдена в {file_path}"
                     f"\n  Searched: {needle!r}"
                     f"{extra}"),
            action="replace_in_file",
            error_code="no_match",
        )

    # --- apply by occurrence ------------------------------------------
    n_occurrences = 0
    if occurrence == "all" or occurrence == -1:
        if tier == 1:
            after = before.replace(needle, repl)
            n_occurrences = total
        else:
            # Tier 2 all: replace every matched range.
            chunks = []
            prev = 0
            for s, e in ranges or []:
                chunks.append(before[prev:s])
                chunks.append(repl)
                prev = e
            chunks.append(before[prev:])
            after = "".join(chunks)
            n_occurrences = len(ranges or [])
    else:
        try:
            occ_num = int(occurrence)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return Result(
                status="error",
                message=f"Некорректное occurrence: {occurrence!r}",
                action="replace_in_file",
                error_code="bad_occurrence",
            )
        if occ_num < 1:
            return Result(
                status="error",
                message=f"occurrence должен быть >= 1, получено {occ_num}",
                action="replace_in_file",
                error_code="bad_occurrence",
            )
        if occ_num > total:
            return Result(
                status="error",
                message=f"Найдено {total} вхождений, нельзя заменить #{occ_num}",
                action="replace_in_file",
                error_code="bad_occurrence",
            )
        if tier == 1:
            pos = -1
            for _ in range(occ_num):
                pos = before.find(needle, pos + 1)
            after = before[:pos] + repl + before[pos + len(needle):]
        else:
            s, e = (ranges or [])[occ_num - 1]
            after = before[:s] + repl + before[e:]
        n_occurrences = 1

    after_out = after.replace("\n", "\r\n") if had_crlf else after
    backend.write(file_path, after_out)
    delta = _delta(before_raw, after_out, n_occurrences)
    msg = _delta_msg(file_path, delta, n_occurrences, total)
    if tier == 2:
        msg += "  (matched with trailing-whitespace normalisation; verify the line above)"
    return Result(
        status="ok",
        message=msg,
        delta=delta,
        verified=True,
        action="replace_in_file",
    )

'''Tests for replace_in_file: 3 tiers + regex.

Covers:
  - tier 1: byte-exact, silent
  - tier 2: trailing whitespace / EOL normalisation, message marked
  - tier 2 ambiguous: two normalised matches, occurrence required
  - tier 3: no match, similar lines marked
  - regex: literal, backrefs, occurrence, no-match

Run: python toolkit/code/toolkit/tests/test_replace_in_file.py
'''
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent.parent))

from toolkit.backends import FilesystemBackend
from toolkit.core import Session
from toolkit.formats import Format
from toolkit.tools import TOOL_MAP


PASS = '[OK]  '
FAIL = '[FAIL]'


class T:
    def __init__(self):
        self.passed = 0
        self.failed = 0

    def expect(self, label, cond, detail=''):
        if cond:
            print(PASS + ' ' + label)
            self.passed += 1
        else:
            print(FAIL + ' ' + label + (' -- ' + detail if detail else ''))
            self.failed += 1


def _run(root: Path, patches):
    backend = FilesystemBackend(root)
    fmt = Format.load('default')
    with Session(backend, fmt=fmt, tools=TOOL_MAP) as s:
        return s.apply_patches(patches)


def _tool(**args):
    return {'action': 'replace_in_file', 'arguments': args}


def main():
    t = T()

    # --- tier 1: exact ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'a.py'
        p.write_text('x = 1\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='a.py', search='x = 1', replace='y = 2')])[0]
        t.expect('tier1 ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)
        t.expect('tier1 applied', p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == 'y = 2\n')
        t.expect('tier1 no marker', 'normalisation' not in r.message)

    # --- tier 2: trailing whitespace ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'b.py'
        p.write_text('foo()  \nbar()\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='b.py', search='foo()', replace='baz()')])[0]
        t.expect('tier2 ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)
        body = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        t.expect('tier2 replaced line', 'baz()' in body, repr(body))
        t.expect('tier2 stripped trailing ws', body == 'baz()\nbar()\n', repr(body))
        t.expect('tier2 marked in message',
                 'normalisation' in r.message, r.message)

    # --- tier 2: multi-line trailing ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'c.py'
        p.write_text('def f():\n    x = 1   \n    return x\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='c.py',
                              search='    x = 1\n    return x',
                              replace='    y = 2\n    return y')])[0]
        t.expect('tier2 multiline ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)
        body = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        t.expect('tier2 multiline replaced', 'y = 2' in body and 'x = 1' not in body)

    # --- tier 2 ambiguous ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'd.py'
        p.write_text('foo()  \nmid()\nfoo()\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='d.py', search='foo()', replace='bar()')])[0]
        # occurrence=1 default; ambiguous -> error
        t.expect('tier2 ambiguous rejected',
                 r.status == 'error' and r.error_code == 'bad_occurrence',
                 f'{r.status}/{r.error_code}')
        # with occurrence=2 -> applies
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='d.py', search='foo()', replace='bar()',
                              occurrence=2)])[0]
        t.expect('tier2 occurrence=2 ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)

    # --- tier 3: no match, similar lines ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'e.py'
        p.write_text('from .model import Block, Part, Unit, UnitKind  \n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='e.py',
                              search='from .core import Something',
                              replace='x')])[0]
        t.expect('tier3 no_match',
                 r.status == 'error' and r.error_code == 'no_match',
                 f'{r.status}/{r.error_code}')
        t.expect('tier3 mentions searched', 'Searched' in r.message, r.message)
        # Similar might pick up L1 given the shared prefix
        t.expect('tier3 shows similar lines or at least searched',
                 'Similar' in r.message or 'Searched' in r.message)

    # --- regex: basic ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'r.py'
        p.write_text('x = 10\ny = 20\nz = 30\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='r.py',
                              search=r'= \d+',
                              replace='= 0',
                              regex=True)])[0]
        t.expect('regex ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)
        body = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        t.expect('regex replaced first only',
                 body == 'x = 0\ny = 20\nz = 30\n', repr(body))

    # --- regex: occurrence=all ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 's.py'
        p.write_text('x = 10\ny = 20\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='s.py',
                              search=r'= \d+',
                              replace='= 0',
                              regex=True,
                              occurrence='all')])[0]
        t.expect('regex all ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)
        body = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        t.expect('regex all replaced', body == 'x = 0\ny = 0\n', repr(body))

    # --- regex: backrefs ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 't.py'
        p.write_text('foo_1 = 1\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='t.py',
                              search=r'(foo)_(\d)',
                              replace=r'\2_\1',
                              regex=True)])[0]
        t.expect('regex backref ok', r.status == 'ok', r.message)
        body = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        t.expect('regex backref swapped', body == '1_foo = 1\n', repr(body))

    # --- regex: no match ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'u.py'
        p.write_text('x = 1\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='u.py', search=r'qq\d+',
                              replace='x', regex=True)])[0]
        t.expect('regex no match',
                 r.status == 'error' and r.error_code == 'no_match',
                 f'{r.status}/{r.error_code}')

    # --- regex: bad pattern ---
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        p = root / 'v.py'
        p.write_text('x = 1\n', encoding='utf-8')
        r = _run(root, [_tool(file_path='v.py', search=r'(unclosed',
                              replace='x', regex=True)])[0]
        t.expect('regex bad pattern',
                 r.status == 'error' and r.error_code == 'bad_regex',
                 f'{r.status}/{r.error_code}')

    print()
    print('=== ' + str(t.passed) + ' ok, ' + str(t.failed) + ' failed ===')
    return 0 if t.failed == 0 else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

args: replace_in_file: tier-2 whitespace tolerance, tier-3 similar lines, regex flag
